basic_info.description: On a coveted, completely flat block in Noe Valley  this bright and serene home offers a refined blend of classic 1940s architecture and thoughtful modern upgrades. Just 6 blocks from the heart of 24th St's village life, steps to MUNI, and a short stroll to the J-Church, the location offers both peaceful retreat and easy access to the best of Noe. Skylights and floor-to-ceiling windows flood the main level w natural light. The heart of the home  a sun-soaked open kitchen, dining, and living space  has been renovated with care and intention. A gorgeous w/b fireplace anchors the spacious living room, while the dining room's wide archways connect seamlessly to both the kitchen and living areas - perfect for entertaining. The chef's kitchen features deep blue cabinetry, quartz countertops, new tile floors, Bertazzoni range, Miele dishwasher, and ample workspace. Two quiet bedrooms open onto a view deck and landscaped backyard. Downstairs, a luxurious third bedroom suite with custom walk-in closet and spa-like bath opens to the resort style backyard - a lush retreat with hillside views, level lawn, and award-winning JML landscaping. Structural, electric + system updates, EV charger, security system, and large garage w interior access. Easy access to 101/280 + tech shuttles. Wow!
